thread:
Leah: Post-launch quick sync. Initial metrics: adoption plateaued, bugs spiking in timeline rendering. Need to decide what is "hotfix this week" vs "next-sprint enhancements". Suggest a simple rule: user-facing breakages + paying-customer impact = hotfix. Everything else goes to enhancements backlog. Thoughts?

Diego: Agreed. From triage: 4 errors causing session loss (hotfix), 6 minor visual glitches in timeline (enhancement), 2 performance regressions during heavy load (maybe hotfix if they affect >5% of sessions).

Sonia: Product vote: prioritize session-loss and the performance regressions that increase p95 by >300ms. Visual polish can wait. We'll need to communicate scope to CS.

Cam: Dev effort estimate: session-loss fixes 1.5d, perf regressions ~2d each to root cause, visual fixes spread 3-4 small PRs (0.5d each).

Ravi: Ops note: rolling a hotfix will need a short maintenance window because of cache invalidation for timeline assets. Recommend canary 2% then 20% then 100% over 3 hours.

Leah: Proposed wave plan: Wave A (this week) = session-loss crashers + perf regressions that meet severity threshold + CS comms. Wave B (next sprint) = visual fixes, accessibility polish, and UX follow-ups. Approve?

Cam: Approve. Can we also freeze nonurgent refactors during hotfix to reduce risk?

Diego: Will create two ticket sets: hotfix-this-week and enhancements-next-sprint. Also adding acceptance criteria for hotfix: no session loss in canary 4h window, p95 within +200ms.

Sonia: I'll draft CS/Enterprise comms and include expected ETA and rollback policy.

Ravi: I'll own canary orchestration and alerts. Auto-rollback if session-loss > 0 or error-rate +0.3%.

QA Bot: CI snapshot: regression suite currently 2 failing flakies and 5 new failures; will prioritize hotfix smoke tests after patch.

Leah: Great. Owners: Diego (triage & PRs), Cam (timeline fix), Ravi (rollout), Sonia (comms), QA Bot (post-deploy verification). Start target: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Follow-up standup 2h after canary kick.

Cam: :thumbsup:

Sonia: :thumbsup:

Diego: PR incoming today.

QA Bot: Smoke runs queued.

Leah: I'll update the roadmap board and move deferred items to the "nice-to-have" lane. Thanks.
